purpose: Enumerate every controlled Clued naming surface before any physical rename, repository migration, Registry Root Catalog construction, Architecture Acceptance, or Structure Freeze decision.

required_surfaces.scope: Every git-index path, basename, path segment, blob identity, content digest, normalization form, and copy-like or lifecycle-like suffix at the exact source commit.
Registered and observed URNs, typed IDs, schema/contract IDs, version tokens, stage tokens, structured JSON identity fields, and their exact locations on selected UTF-8 text and machine surfaces.
All paginated repository branches, tags, releases, release assets, workflow definitions, and non-expired or historical Actions artifact metadata available through the repository token.
README, AGENTS, CURRENT_STATUS, manifests, indexes, status routers, generated projections, and any source/status/freshness metadata used by humans or agents.

Metadata-only listing of Clued-related Library folders and files, including duplicate-safe suffixes, physical-copy identifiers, sizes, timestamps, and durable closeout locations. File contents are read only when separately justified.

Project, schema, table, column, function, policy, storage bucket, edge function, auth redirect, and deployment identifiers that are controlled by Clued. No private row payload is required for naming inventory.
Worker, Pages project, deployment, route, domain, binding, environment, and related external resource identifiers; retired resources require explicit retirement evidence rather than silent omission.
Developer Skill, User Skill, vendor projection, mechanism revision, adapter, provider, capability, runtime, and activation pointer names in repository and connected systems.
All active and historical typed identities, filenames, aliases, digests, version axes, domain/program/stage bindings, and consumers for candidates, decisions, evidence, receipts, and authorizations.

content_exclusions.rule: Do not read private user record bodies merely to inventory names. Inventory only metadata and identifiers required to classify the surface.
Inventory secret or binding names only; never read or persist secret values.
